    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RemainingSaws" name="Send remaining chainsaws to customer" messageRef="Msg_RemainingSaws">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderNotContinued" name="Rest of order not produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomOrder" targetRef="UserTask_DetermineProperties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="UserTask_DetermineProperties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="SendTask_Update"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Event_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrived" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_AssembleParts" targetRef="SendTask_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="Event_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Event_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerLikesSaw == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="End_OrderNotContinued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" targetRef="SendTask_RemainingSaws"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="SendTask_RemainingSaws" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
